notes: 'asher takes because as the connective the ASV wrote for it rather than being marked unrepresented beside an added conjunction.
The 'et before Jehovah is the preposition H854 by MACULA's tagging, not the object marker, so it takes with (rule 16's closing caution).
The explicit pronoun hemmah takes only These and the copula goes to the predicate mey (rule 20).
